title: Every vector Dψ(v)a is the velocity of a C¹ curve in N
statement: Let P, r, d ∈ ℕ with r ≥ 1, N ⊆ ℝ^P, V ⊆ ℝ^d open, and ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P of class C^r on V with ψ(V) ⊆ N. Then for every v ∈ V, Dψ(v)(ℝ^d) ⊆ tangentSpace N (ψ(v)), where Dψ(v) = fderiv ℝ ψ v. Here tangentSpace N y is the set of w ∈ ℝ^P for which some γ : ℝ → ℝ^P is C¹ on (−1, 1), maps (−1, 1) into N, and satisfies γ(0) = y and γ'(0) = w (HasDerivAt γ w 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P r d : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P), 1 ≤ r → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ r ψ V → ψ '' V ⊆ N → ∀ v ∈ V, Set.range (fderiv ℝ ψ v) ⊆ tangentSpace N (ψ v)
